Senses.Explanation: The mind's inborn luminity counted as one whole stretch, shining before birth and waiting to be reclaimed from ink and clamor. Zhufeng Zhenxu, on the ghost festival, sets autumn-pool moon-shadow and still-night bell-sound around one stretch of light that never dulls, and warns that whoever only half-grasps it is a dead man whose soul has not scattered; Hongzhi Zhengjue hangs the bright moon of a frost sky over the central peak and lets one stretch of light wash the dull darkness; Yezhu Fuhui, tonsuring the layman Chen Qin, takes up the upward hammer to spark the stretch of light behind that newly shaven head; and Qibai Defu, in xiaocan, declares the stretch shone on heaven before leaving the womb and lights the earth after, endowed in everyone, undimmed in the fool, unincreased in the sage. Ruibai Mingxue, writing to the layman Zhang Wofu, rules that with no second person or second thought to be found it is only one's own one stretch of light — set your eyes there and stop seeking outward; Shanhui Huan, recounting his own years in the lecture halls, groans that the stretch of light of the buddhas and ancestors was buried under ink and letters; Baiyu Jingsi, at the news of Yongjue's death, watches the old man's final stretch of light shoot three thousand miles into Yusi peak; and Lingji Xingguan, answering the scholar Zhu, orders him to squeeze out at full speed the sky-covering, earth-bearing stretch of light until it streams from his chest.
